name: graphoscope
description: Send a Markdown document from Claude Code to your own devices running Graphoscope (Markdown viewer and editor): end-to-end encrypted, saved in your iCloud Drive and pinned on your iPhone, iPad and Mac.

pairing_code.title: Graphoscope pairing code
pairing_code.description: In Graphoscope: Settings › Receive from Claude Code › Turn On, then copy the pairing code (gph1.…). It links this plugin to your own devices only.
